svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Multimodal Avatar Lip-Sync & Visual Co-Browsing Architecture (Stage 375 · P743–P744)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of cloud video avatar bandwidth starvation & visual prompt injection vs P743 ITU-R BT.1359 lip-sync skew lock (<=45ms) + audio-first congestion drop and P744 Co-Browsing DOM PII masking + viewportEpoch synchronization.
svg.text: STAGE 375 · TOPIC 15 · P743–P744
Multimodal Avatar Lip-Sync (<=45ms) & Co-Browsing Viewport Safety
多模态数字人唇音同步与同屏协办架构选型：ITU-R BT.1359 唇形对齐+弱网保音弃画 (P743) 与同屏 DOM 遮罩+视口纪元锁 (P744)
① P743: Avatar Lip-Sync (<=45ms Skew) & Audio-First Congestion Drop
⛔ Legacy Cloud Video Avatar Over Lossy Mobile Network
• 1080p Cloud Avatar stream hogs 2.5 Mbps -> starves 32 kbps Opus voice on 4G!
• Audio arrives 220ms before video -> uncanny-valley "badly dubbed movie" effect
• On caller barge-in, zombie avatar mouth keeps flapping for 600ms after audio stops!
ITU-R BT.1359-1 Threshold: Humans notice A/V skew beyond +45ms (audio lead) / -125ms (audio lag)
✅ P743: Client Viseme Driver / RTCP SR Sync (<=45ms) + Audio-First Drop
1. Client-Side Viseme Driven vs Cloud Pixel Stream: Send 2 kbps Viseme IDs alongside
Opus audio for mobile apps (99% less bandwidth); reserve Cloud Pixel Avatar for kiosks
2. Tight Lip-Sync Lock (|avSkewMs| <= 45ms): Align RTP timestamps via RTCP SR
wallclock and flush viseme/video buffers in 0ms when turnEpoch increments on barge-in
3. Audio-First Graceful Degradation: Drop video to static portrait + waveform when
available bandwidth < 600 kbps, protecting DSCP EF voice intelligibility 100%
P743 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P744: Co-Browsing DOM PII Masking & Viewport Epoch Lock
Multimodal Voice Modality Selection Matrix
• Modality A: Pure Audio Stream — Best for PSTN, driving, eyes-busy field ops (32 kbps)
• Modality B: Voice + Visual Co-Browsing / UI Cards (P744 Recommended for App/Web CS)
3x faster form completion than reading tables aloud; uses lightweight SCTP DataChannel
• Modality C: Voice + 2D/3D Digital Human Avatar (P743 for Kiosks / Wealth / Tutoring)
High visual empathy; requires <=45ms lip-sync lock & audio-priority fallback
✅ P744: Client-Side DOM Redaction & Viewport-Epoch Click Fence
• Pre-Capture DOM/Canvas Masking: Mask password/CVV/SSN fields ([data-pii]) on the
client before capturing screenshots or DOM trees for the multimodal model
• Anti-Visual Prompt Injection: Strip opacity:0 / font-size:0 / off-screen text nodes
that attempt to hijack the voice agent via hidden webpage text
• Viewport Epoch Fence: Block stale UI clicks if user scrolled (viewportDriftPx <= 16px)
P744 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 375 · DIMENSION 378)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P743/P744): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• Live WebRTC Video Rendering & DOM Capture: GPU viseme rendering FPS and RTCP SR network jitter are not_measured in local unit tests.
